patthana10.2:1.1: na kusalaṃ na sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na kusalaṃ na sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na akusalo na sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na kusalaṃ na sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na sahetuko ca na akusalo na sahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā:
patthana10.2:2.1: tīṇi. na akusalaṃ na sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na akusalo na sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na akusalaṃ na sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na akusalaṃ na sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na sahetuko ca na akusalo na sahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā:
patthana10.2:3.1: tīṇi. na abyākataṃ na sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
